answer: The p-value for age as a predictor of partial response (PR) in the combined logistic regression PR ~ BMI + Age + Gender is 0.0025 (Wald z-test; age coefficient −0.0795, SE 0.0263, OR 0.924 per year, 95% CI 0.877–0.972). Younger age is significantly associated with PR (p = 0.0025). BMI was not significant (p = 0.136; OR 1.176 per kg/m²), nor was female gender vs male reference (p = 0.262; OR 1.846, 95% CI 0.632–5.395).
